nodes.label: Decision: Kanban as a second Tauri window
nodes.rationale: Matches original observed behavior and solves the real two-monitor case; same process shares AppState and events for free.
nodes.norm_label: decision: kanban as a second tauri window

nodes.label: Decision: event-delta sync, no polling
nodes.rationale: Polling wastes resources and cannot deliver the perceived <1s update; the event carries the affected task so the board never reloads everything.

nodes.label: Decision: normalized Map state, columns derived
nodes.rationale: A card changes column by mutating one field, avoiding moving between arrays and duplicate risk under concurrent transitions.
nodes.norm_label: decision: normalized map state, columns derived

nodes.label: Decision: no drag-and-drop between columns in v1
nodes.rationale: Not observed in the reference product and conflicts with the state machine: dragging to Completed would skip the mandatory testing phase.
nodes.norm_label: decision: no drag-and-drop between columns in v1

nodes.label: Decision: independent per-column scroll
nodes.rationale: A board with one full column and others empty becomes unusable if the whole container scrolls together.

nodes.label: Traceability Marker (SPEC: comment convention)
nodes.rationale: Every file created/edited to implement a requirement carries a `// SPEC: <feature> (<IDs>)` comment before imports, so implementation traces back to a spec requirement ID. IDs must be real, per-feature prefixes already defined in .specs/features/<name>/spec.md; inventing an ID is forbidden. Verified via `grep -rn "SPEC:" src/ src-tauri/src/`.

nodes.label: cargo build --workspace redundancy (corrected gate description)
nodes.rationale: The Cargo workspace has no default-members restriction, so plain `cargo build` already compiles both src-tauri and crates/swarmdeck-mcp; `--workspace` is valid but redundant, not required. Triage 007 found the run-006 claim (that --workspace was needed) false via `cargo metadata` and corrected AGENTS.md's Build & test table.
